name: Avar Lancers

abilities.name: Wedge
abilities.text: The unit moves into a wedge-shaped attack formation.

attributes.name: Fire Whilst Moving
attributes.text: This unit can fire when mounted and moving.

short: Armour? It is nothing once the lancers set their targets.
history: Developed from the cavalry skills of their ancestors, lancers were a type of heavy cavalry. Those of the nomadic steppe tribes wore scale armour to protect themselves and their mounts, and used a long lance known as a kontos, which enabled them to deliver devastating charges in a fashion comparable to the deadly cataphract cavalry from the east. Their scale armour was made from horn, or later metal, and allowed its wearers to easily run down their western counterparts. However, lancers were still vulnerable to dense pike or spear-armed formations. Archery provided a solution: sustained volleys from skirmishing foot and horse archers were used to thin and spread out the enemy prior to a devastating, thunderous charge.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
